capabilities: Map folders, single notes, or the whole vault to Dify Knowledge Bases
Sync manually or automatically on create, modify, and rename events
Upload Markdown as text and optionally sync YAML properties as Dify metadata
Reuse recorded Dify document IDs for updates and renames
Test the Dify API key and load available knowledge bases
extras: Desktop-only; mobile support is not enabled. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed installation, user, and troubleshooting guides are linked separately.
problem: Notes kept in Obsidian are not available to Dify knowledge-base Q&A unless they are uploaded and kept current by hand.

relations.evidence: Sync selected Obsidian Markdown notes to one or more Dify Knowledge Bases.

summary: Desktop plugin that syncs selected Markdown notes, including YAML properties, to one or more Dify Knowledge Bases for Q&A use.
